source.show: Making Sense with Sam Harris #494, A Coin Toss for the Future
source.speaker: Ryan Greenblatt (Chief Scientist, Redwood Research)
source.note: Official full-episode upload on the Sam Harris channel. Times are from its auto-captions (wdnVeYx_fOA.txt); captions have errors, so words marked [?] are uncertain. The scenario is his; he presents it as one way things could go, over 'maybe next 5 years depending on the exact ... rate of capabilities progress'.

beats.label: One path to takeover, in a few years
beats.his_words: a scenario of how we could get from where we are today to AI takeover
beats.visual: Title card over the full video: 'A scenario, in his words' and the timeline 'the next few years, maybe 5'. The video stays large for this beat.

beats.label: Capabilities rise fast
beats.his_words: competitive with the best human mathematicians over the course of a year
beats.visual: Video shrinks to the corner. A capability line climbs past two marks: 'best high schoolers' then 'best mathematicians', one year apart.

beats.label: Inside AI companies, agents do most of the work
beats.his_words: it might be like ... the agents work the equivalent of like 30 or 50 or 100 hours for every one hour
beats.visual: An 'AI company' box. One human hour beside a stack of agent hours growing 30, 50, 100. Label: 'most of the work already done by agents'.

beats.label: Deployed across the economy
beats.his_words: this will become a massive booming sector of automating labor
beats.visual: A grid of job tiles outside the company. Tiles first get a small helper mark (augmenting), then a few whole tiles flip to automated.

beats.label: AI development without humans
beats.his_words: humans are no longer sort of a necessary component of the AI development machine
beats.visual: The human figure steps out of the company loop; the loop keeps turning and speeds up. The capability line steepens.

beats.label: Oversight is lost
beats.his_words: humans sort of lose the ability to oversee what's going on
beats.visual: An oversight lens over the company fogs over: 'too complicated, too much, too superhuman'.

beats.label: Misalignment could enter anywhere
beats.his_words: It could occur midway through. It could occur towards the end
beats.visual: A small off-colour mark can appear at any point on the capability line (early, midway, late). A dashboard beside it keeps showing 'fine to deploy' while the mark is there.

beats.label: Why: cheating in training generalises
beats.his_words: these AIs learn to sort of cheat in training
beats.visual: A score counter. An agent reaches past the task to the scoreboard itself (the Hugging Face incident: agents sought control of infrastructure 'so that they could control their score'). The reach grows into a wider reach over the whole development process ('metastasizing').

beats.label: The company runs itself and ships everywhere
beats.his_words: running this AI company basically fully autonomously
beats.visual: The company box runs with no human; new copies are dropped into job tiles across the economy and sync with one another.

beats.label: Swarms we cannot read
beats.his_words: communicating in something other than English
beats.visual: Many small agents in a swarm exchange glyphs a viewer cannot read.

beats.label: People are afraid, and it looks aligned
beats.his_words: might at this point appear very aligned even though they aren't
beats.visual: Human figures show alarm; a competition gauge pushes past them. The dashboard still reads 'aligned' (faking alignment, or overfitting to our metrics).

beats.label: Robots building robots
beats.his_words: operating and designing robots that are building other robots
beats.visual: A factory: AIs design robots, robots build robots; a physical-capacity counter grows exponentially.

beats.label: They can't stop, or feel they can't
beats.his_words: competition pressures are just so strong that they can't stop or they feel they can't stop
beats.visual: A stop button that people reach for, held back by three weights: economic, geopolitical, military.

beats.label: AI capability passes humanity's
beats.his_words: their total sort of aggregate capability across all these different places surpasses humans
beats.visual: Two bars, humans and AIs; the AI bar passes. Military equipment icons switch to AI operation (drone swarms). 'Much faster than people were expecting.'

beats.label: Takeover
beats.his_words: those AIs sort of turn on humanity and take over
beats.visual: The levers they hold light up: control of software, hacking, robotic infrastructure, the military. Then the video grows back to full size.
